items.difficulty_reason: Glueing deformations of a scheme along an open cover: reduction to showing the restriction functors give an equivalence of deformation categories, an explicit quasi-inverse built from the two pieces and their identified overlap via the schemes glueing lemma, with the special-fibre check written; functoriality verification of the construction omitted. Retained author proof at lines 1664-1698.
